subject: RE: somewhere to sell
body: You'd build a little marketplace? That would help more people than me. Listings with a photo and a price, search, a way to contact the seller, and marking things sold. That's all I'd need.

outcomes.when: the player offers or agrees to take the job: to build, make, create, do, help with or take on the classifieds marketplace, in any wording ("happy to help", "I can do that", "count me in"); not a refusal or an unrelated question
outcomes.reply: Thank you. Truly. I'll list the watch the moment it's up.

hints: Offer to build him the marketplace.
